posts.topic: Tariffs Are Now a Permanent Cost Line
posts.hook: CFOs say price growth would be 25% lower in 2026 without tariff impact.
posts.key_stat: Median CFO expects 3.5% price growth; Grant Thornton expects 4.5% unit cost growth in 2026.
posts.source: Fed Bank of Richmond / Duke Fuqua CFO Survey; Grant Thornton Q1 2026
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card leading with 25% in large type, supporting cost-growth figures beneath, formal enterprise palette with no decorative hype.
